title: Rorca — Phase 4: MCP Layer (Direction Stack Auto-Injection)
description: Add an MCP (Model Context Protocol) server to Rorca so Claude Code sessions can natively query the Direction Stack, generate specs, and check pipeline status — without opening the browser UI. The headline feature: rorca_get_context auto-injects the synthesized Direction Stack into every Claude Code session that requests it. Built as a thin wrapper over the existing Express routes (Phase 1–3). Gate to Phase 5: all 5 MCP tools registered and callable from Claude Code, Direction Stack synthesis returns within 200ms, rorca_generate_spec returns a valid spec JSON, no breaking changes to existing Phase 1–3 routes.
